_help: Settings of the M2 -> CSP migration. Edit here or in the UI (Settings). Every key is optional.

company_map._help: M2 mandate holder (trust mandate code, e.g. IT) -> name of the Odoo operating company. A mandate whose holder is not listed goes to review: never a default company.

employee_map._help: M2 employee abbreviation (Kuerzel) -> employee name in Odoo. Empty map: the M2 value is passed through and the import checks it.

officer_types._help: M2 Detail addr. Type code (e.g. DIR, BO, CP) -> register sheet: directors, ubos, shareholders, secretaries, agents, contacts, signatories or ignore. Codes not listed are read by their wording (Director, Secretary...); unknown ones go to review.

file_kinds._help: File name (or start of it) -> source kind, when the automatic classification picks the wrong one. Kinds: mandates, addresses, contacts, officers, directors, ubos, shareholders, secretaries, agents, bank_accounts, signatories, fees, open_items, compliance, documents, inventory, ignore.

extra_aliases._help: Source kind -> {field: [extra column headers]} added to the built-in header names.
